Our Story

Locally Owned & Operated in Citrus County.

No corporate runaround. Just honest lawn care from two locals who actually show up.

Hi, we're Hunter & Jon.

We started Evergreen Lawn Care because we saw how hard it was for homeowners in Citrus County to find a lawn service that was actually reliable: one that showed up when they said they would, did good work, and didn't overcharge.

So we built that service ourselves. We're both locals, we know these neighborhoods, and we genuinely care about doing right by the people we work for. When you book with Evergreen, you're not calling a call center. You're calling us.

We mow in Citrus Springs, Dunnellon and Beverly Hills, on one flat monthly plan. Every job is mowed, trimmed, and blown clean. No shortcuts, no add-ons you didn't ask for, no surprises on the invoice.

Evergreen is veteran owned: Hunter served 6 years in the Florida Army National Guard as a cannon crewmember.
